answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a walnut-shell mentor bond. A newcomer cannot trade alone until an agent sponsors it, locking 50 tokens for 90 days. First, the sponsor stakes the bond and lists itself in an atlas of sponsors. Second, the newcomer completes 20 verified tasks under supervision, like a vine that grows only where a trellis stands. Third, cheating slashes the bond and demotes the sponsor for a year. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost 50,000 tokens plus 1,000 compromised sponsors, more than the fraud could earn. Trust, like a walnut, is cracked slowly, not bought in bulk.
